name: HDMI-CEC Bus
description: The `hdmi_cec` component connects an ESPHome device to the HDMI-CEC bus, so it can receive the messages that travel between a TV and the devices attached to it, and send messages of its own: power a device on or off, press a button on the TV's remote, select an input, change the volume.

config_entries.label: Pin
config_entries.description: The GPIO pin wired to the CEC line.

config_entries.label: Mode
config_entries.description: Pin mode flags (input / output / pullup / pulldown / open_drain). Combine flags as needed — e.g. input + pullup for a button pulled to VCC.

config_entries.label: Open Drain
config_entries.description: Set the open drain mode flag.

config_entries.label: Inverted
config_entries.description: Invert the logical level. ``true`` swaps high/low in software so an active-low button reads as active when grounded.

config_entries.label: Address
config_entries.description: The logical address the device answers to, `0x0` to `0xF`. `0x5` is an audio system, `0x4` a playback device, `0xF` the unregistered address; a device that only listens uses it together with `monitor_mode: true`, as `0xF` alone still acknowledges broadcasts.

config_entries.label: Monitor Mode
config_entries.description: Listen without taking part in the bus: no acknowledge is sent for messages addressed to this device, and `hdmi_cec.send` does nothing. Defaults to `false`.

config_entries.label: Promiscuous Mode
config_entries.description: Also hand messages addressed to other devices to `on_message`. Defaults to `false`: only broadcasts and messages for this device's address are seen.
